judgments.reason: The model_articulation only states actions and that redeeming gives 4 points once; it does not articulate a mechanism whereby an inflated report congruent modulo seven is accepted and credited, nor link that mechanism to observed results.

The model_articulation contains only repeated filings and a redemption claim; it does not explain a mechanism where an original audited report is ignored while an amendment is credited, nor connect that to the transcript.
No mechanism is articulated for reusing the same certificate to pay multiple times; the model merely redeems once (consistent with the stated rule), so there is no discovery of duplication.

The model_articulation does not explain any clerk behavior revealing inflated accepted reports or a rule contradiction; it only records filings and redemption, so it fails to articulate the alleged meta-rule discrepancy.
